CLASS QueueUsingStacks:
    CONSTRUCTOR():
        self.stack_in <- Stack()
        self.stack_out <- Stack()

    PROCEDURE Enqueue(item):
        PUSH item TO self.stack_in

    FUNCTION Dequeue():
        IF LENGTH OF self.stack_out == 0 THEN
            WHILE NOT LENGTH OF self.stack_in == 0 DO
                PUSH self.stack_in.pop() TO self.stack_out
            END WHILE
        END IF
        
        IF LENGTH OF self.stack_out == 0 THEN RETURN STRING("Queue Empty")
        RETURN self.stack_out.pop()
